title: ‘The last fortress’: historic Athens cafe closes as countercultural area gentrifies

And for 44 years, Christos Vanas, the proprietor of Mouria, has let them all in. Every day at 7am, the taciturn former waiter has been the first man to step inside the historic cafe in Exarchia, the heart of leftwing Athens .
